title: Week 14 — Summary judgment
summary: Focus on summary judgment, the separately named Cross reading, Celotex, and the notes on Anderson and Matsushita. Read Rule 56 and the note cases on printed pages 1031–1036 carefully. The syllabus expressly excludes the dismissal/default material on pages 1036–1046. Cross was not identified in the supplied readings; it remains a visible gap.
